confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Jakarta prices, projected to July 2026 with an allowance for local inflation. Not checked against live menus, rate cards or listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately grounded; hostel, hotel and wine anchors are less certain. USD values assume roughly 16,500-17,500 IDR per USD, which was not separately verified. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about 3x beer; wine about 3.3x beer, reflecting import duty) because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. The FX observation was located via web search; no 15 October 2026 reading was found, so 14 October is the latest located.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Anchored on Jakarta's own remembered price levels, cross-checked loosely against other large Southeast Asian capitals such as Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok for mid-range dining and budget accommodation, and adjusted upward for Indonesia's high alcohol taxes and wine import duties.
